title: Drafts in Zo are in folders with brief, descriptive names
details: Zo folders are "<brief name> (<first 8 of id>).draft". The connected model writes the 2–5 word name once a draft settles (ZoSync.nameDrafts, briefName in desktop/writing.ts); it's stored in <id>.draft/name.json, synced, and rewritten only after a large change in length (renameDue). Without a model, folders use the title. Sync still keys files by draft ID; older <id>.draft folders are renamed on the next full check, and files a draft has in another folder are moved into its own (ZoSync.gather).

title: Updates list what’s new in a few short lines
details: release-notes.json entries are {title, details}. Installed apps get only the titles, in the signed manifest’s notes; details go to the GitHub release body. Updates leaves out notes the release you’re running already listed (Updates.news in desktop/updates.ts).

title: The Features box shows a blinking cursor while you type
details: caret::poll in native/rune-prototype/src/caret.rs now tracks the feature-request field on Settings › Features.
